data.name: Rifaah
data.gender_notes: Rifaah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is contented with what he has and finds pleasure in it. The name Rifaah carries the meaning “Contented, satisfied, pleased” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Rifaah usually hope their child will grow to embody contented, satisfied, pleased and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for someone who is spiritually content and at peace with their inner self.
data.etymology: Rifaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Contented, satisfied, pleased.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rifaah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rifaah carries a sense of contentment and satisfaction, which can positively influence one's character and interactions with others. In Middle Eastern and Islamic cultures, contentment and being grateful for what one has is highly valued. The name Rifaah can serve as a reminder to appreciate the blessings in life and to strive for inner peace, which, in turn, can lead to stronger relationships and harmonious communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name Rifaah holds spiritual significance as it implies a connection to Allah through contentment and satisfaction with the divine will. According to Ahadith (collected sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad), true contentment and satisfaction come from Allah and is a sign of faith and submission to His will. The name Rifaah can serve as a reminder to seek Allah's pleasure and to be grateful for the blessings that come from Him. It encourages a daily practice of inner reflection and a constant striving towards being better versions of ourselves as we navigate through life's challenges and experiences.
